lines.trans: If you stay silent, I will leave now.
Wait, I will tell you everything.
I hid the money in a kindergarten.
In a kindergarten? That cannot be!
An old female acquaintance of mine works there.
She was a close female friend of mine.
But that was very long ago.
Are you satisfied with my answer now?
And I am not interested in that at all!
I simply asked out of curiosity.
Are you jealous of my past?
Nothing of the sort, you mean nothing to me!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: belonging to children or from childhood

examples.trans: This is an old children's book.

meanings.note: short form: ты довольна? = are you happy?
condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?
goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: Thank you for the honest answer.
I love our town very much.
I'll invite a female friend over.
Are you jealous of my past?

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin

examples.text: Сейчас через сад и мост — и дома.
examples.trans: Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.
The children are walking in the town park.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
